protocol.revision_reason: V1 floor-only 0.5 yielded effective contact friction 1.0 due to MuJoCo max combination. V2 sets floor and robot sliding friction together, asserts actual contacts, and restores subtree mass caches between conditions. V1 retained as diagnostics; thresholds/policies unchanged.
protocol.floor_friction: equal-priority floor and robot geoms receive the same sliding friction; every actual floor contact is checked against the condition value
protocol.episode: one start-at-zero trial per reference per condition; no autoreset; retain failures

pad.type: fixed kinematic box with real collision response; not a simulated opponent or calibrated punching bag
pad.front_face: original virtual goal; normal = normalized horizontal vector from initial pelvis to goal
pad.valid_strike: correct effector contacts pad in window, pad-front normal alignment >=0.5, normal force >=10N, preceding-step nominal striking-point approach velocity >=0.1m/s
pad.velocity_note: nominal striking point before the physics step; a proxy, not exact material-point impact velocity

protocol.mass_comparison_baseline: nominal_mass_constants_refresh; both mass conditions and this control call mj_setConst after runtime armature assignment
protocol.claims: bounded zero-shot stress/contact test of two checkpoints; no universal robustness, force-calibrated hardware, or novel-model claim
